A second alarm fire broke out in a residential area along Sampaguita Street, Kahilom 1, Barangay 870 in Pandacan, Manila on Thursday, March 5, according to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP). Firefighters and volunteer brigades responded as residents evacuated their homes to safety.

Authorities are still determining the cause of the fire, as well as the number of families affected and the extent of damage.
No casualties or injuries have been reported as of posting time. | via Diann Calucin
